newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia says cancels Bre-X work approval.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia says cancels Bre-X work approval.

text.p: Indonesian Mines and Energy Minister Ida Bagus Sudjana said on Wednesday the government had cancelled parliamentary approval for contracts of work sought by Canada's Bre-X Minerals Ltd to develop the Busang II and III gold properties in East Kalimantan.
"We cancel it. The Bre-X contract of work will be processed from the beginning," Sudjana told reporters following a parliamentary commission hearing.

During the parliamentary hearing, the secretary-general of the Mines and Energy Ministry, Umar Said, said the ministry was also looking into whether Bre-X had misrepresented its status over the Busang find to the New York Stock Exchange Commission.
He said ministry lawyers had obtained a series of documents which he said showed Bre-X had claimed it owned the Busang II and III properties which contain the bulk of the gold.
"Maybe that was meant to push up the price of its shares," Umar said.
"We are checking with Bapepam (the Indonesian Capital Markets Supervisory Agency) to see if this is criminal," he said.
Bre-X is listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange.
